LESSON: PHONEMIC AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.1: Phonemic awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Phonemic awareness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practice left-right eye movement 4 lessons
2. isolate sounds in a word
3. segment words that start with similar sounds
4. recognize all the letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area(visual discrimination)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. practice left-right eye movement 4 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice left-right eye movement 4 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. isolate sounds in a word
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to isolate sounds in a word. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. segment words that start with similar sounds
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to segment words that start with similar sounds. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. recognize all the letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area(visual discrimination)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize all the letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area(visual discrimination). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Phonemic awareness.
2. Explain Phonemic awareness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonemic awareness.
4. Show that you can: practice left-right eye movement 4 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonemic awareness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Phonemic awareness important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. practice left-right eye movement 4 lessons
2. isolate sounds in a word
3. segment words that start with similar sounds
4. recognize all the letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area letters of the alphabet in the language of the catchment area(visual discrimination)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
